seo.title: Thank you: consultation booked
seo.description: Your consultation with Calwebtech is booked. Here is what the confirmation email contains, how to reschedule and how to prepare for the call.

title: Thanks. Your consultation is booked.
intro: The time you chose is reserved for you. A confirmation email with a calendar invite is on its way to the address you gave.

received.heading: What you sent us
items: The type of consultation, the date and the time you chose, in your timezone
Your name, email address and company
What you want to cover on the call

response.label: Confirmation
response.detail: It carries a calendar invite and links to reschedule or cancel. Reminders follow a day and an hour before the call.

steps.title: We prepare
steps.body: The people who would run your project look at your current site first, so the call is useful rather than exploratory.

steps.title: Change the time if you need to
steps.body: Use the link in your confirmation email to reschedule or cancel. There is no need to call or write to us.

steps.title: We tell you what we would do
steps.body: On the call you hear what we would change, roughly what it costs and whether we are the right fit. Send your NDA beforehand if you need one.

secondary.heading: Before the call
secondary.body: Read through the five stages of a project so you can ask about the parts that matter most to you.

image.alt: A project team planning a website with sticky notes on a whiteboard
